name: Morrison Springs Park
area: Walton County, near Ponce de Leon
coordinateNote: FDEP Water Quality Portal spring monitoring point, rounded; navigate to park address rather than the water marker.
navigationAddress: 874 Morrison Springs Road, Ponce de Leon, FL 32455
experience: A broad, 250-foot-wide spring bowl with underwater cavities, a dive dock and boardwalks overlooking the water. name: Big Scrub Campground
coordinateNote: Entrance, parking or campsite coordinates from the November 12, 2026 research.
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: Forty-seven open sites in the sand pine scrub, built for off-road riders, so expect ATV noise by day. A workable shower stop between Juniper Springs and Alexander Springs. Gate open 8 a.m. to 8 p.m.
access: Book and pay ahead. Stay limit: 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period Ocala WMA general gun season is Nov 14, 2026 - Jan 10, 2027 in the Pipeline, Hopkins Prairie and Lake Delancy units (Church Lake Unit on the far west edge: Nov 14-22 and Nov 28 - Dec 6). FWC 2026-27 brochure: 'During the general gun season, camping is prohibited, except in designated campgrounds and Juniper Prairie Wilderness.' Forest Service: 'Camping is allowed only in designated campsites during general gun season.' This is a designated campground, so it stays legal for the whole trip. Hunters will be on the surrounding forest roads; deer hunters must wear 500 sq in of fluorescent orange, and it is sensible to wear orange on trails outside the campground.

conditions.summary: Availability changes. Compare the saved individual site and night below, then confirm with the operator.
